description: This file implements a SOCKS4 proxy server using Perl modules for socket handling, including UNIX domain sockets and TCP sockets. It listens for client connections, handles SOCKS4 handshake, and facilitates TCP proxying between clients and destination servers.

methods.name: main script execution flow
methods.description: Sets up a UNIX domain socket server, accepts client connections, performs SOCKS4 handshake, and proxies TCP data between client and remote server.
